Dreamcost2026-08-28
Weekly model spend quadrupled to $158 AUD - v4-pro output and reasoning tokens exploded 10x in a single week
Your total model spend jumped from $23.80 USD to $101.72 USD ($157.66 AUD) in one week. v4-pro alone accounts for $85.18 USD (84% of spend), with output tokens surging from 624K to 6.47M across the two routing paths. The direct-path v4-pro produced 4.76M output tokens on just 13.6M fresh input - a 35% output-to-input ratio that suggests the model is generating far more than it is reading. Add another 2.41M reasoning tokens (1.5M direct + 913K openrouter) and v4-pro is producing 8.88M generation tokens per week. The flash models are running efficiently: deepseek-v4-flash handles 24.8M input for $2.73 with only 345K output. The opportunity is on v4-pro: check whether reasoning/thinking mode is enabled on sessions where it does not need it, and whether long-running sessions are generating verbose output through context re-reading (1.24 billion cache-read tokens across v4-pro paths reinforces the context-rot concern). Even routing 25% of v4-pro work to flash or trimming avoidable output saves ~$140 AUD/month.
